from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
import time

with sync_playwright() as p:
    # Launch Chrome (try to use existing or launch new)
    browser = p.chromium.launch(
        executable_path=r'C:\Users\Administrator\AppData\Local\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe',
        headless=False,
        args=['--start-maximized']
    )
    context = browser.contexts[0] if browser.contexts else browser.new_context()
    page = context.new_page()
    page.goto('https://gez.dongguanbank.cn/landlord/#/login')
    page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle', timeout=15000)
    
    # Get page title
    print('Page title:', page.title())
    
    # Take a screenshot to see the page
    page.screenshot(path='screenshot_login.png')
    print('Screenshot saved')
    
    # Try to find and fill the login form
    try:
        # Wait for form elements
        page.wait_for_selector('input', timeout=5000)
        inputs = page.query_selector_all('input')
        print(f'Found {len(inputs)} input elements')
        for i, inp in enumerate(inputs):
            inp_type = inp.get_attribute('type') or 'text'
            inp_placeholder = inp.get_attribute('placeholder') or ''
            inp_name = inp.get_attribute('name') or ''
            print(f'  Input {i}: type={inp_type}, placeholder={inp_placeholder}, name={inp_name}')
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'Error finding inputs: {e}')
    
    browser.close()
"

from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
import time

with sync_playwright() as p:
    browser = p.chromium.launch(
        executable_path=r'C:\Users\Administrator\AppData\Local\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe',
        headless=False
    )
    context = browser.contexts[0] if browser.contexts else browser.new_context()
    page = context.new_page()
    page.goto('https://gez.dongguanbank.cn/landlord/#/login')
    page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle', timeout=15000)
    time.sleep(1)
    
    # Fill in the login form
    # Input 0: phone/username
    # Input 1: password
    
    page.fill('input[type=\"text\"]', '18926879306')
    print('Filled username')
    
    page.fill('input[type=\"password\"]', '100911yzpYZP')
    print('Filled password')
    
    # Take a screenshot to verify
    page.screenshot(path='screenshot_filled.png')
    print('Screenshot after filling')
    
    # Find and click the login button
    buttons = page.query_selector_all('button')
    print(f'Found {len(buttons)} buttons')
    for i, btn in enumerate(buttons):
        btn_text = btn.inner_text()
        btn_type = btn.get_attribute('type') or ''
        print(f'  Button {i}: text={btn_text}, type={btn_type}')
    
    # Try to find the submit button and click it
    try:
        # Look for button with type submit or with login text
        submit_btn = page.query_selector('button[type=\"submit\"]')
        if submit_btn:
            submit_btn.click()
            print('Clicked submit button')
        else:
            # Try clicking the last button (usually submit)
            if buttons:
                buttons[-1].click()
                print('Clicked last button')
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'Error clicking button: {e}')
    
    time.sleep(2)
    page.screenshot(path='screenshot_after_login.png')
    print('Screenshot after login attempt')
    print('Current URL:', page.url)
    
    browser.close()
    print('Done')
"
